cases.case_label: 279 bp Alu in F9 exon H
cases.mechanism_detail: Recent germline Alu (from a subfamily not previously known to be active) inserted into F9 exon H (letter-numbered exon) causing hemophilia B; transcript effect not described in abstract.
cases.quote: 1) a 279 bp insertion in exon H originating from an Alu family of short interspersed elements not previously known to be active and, 2) a 463 bp insertion in exon E of a LINE1 element originating in the maternal grandmother.

cases.case_label: 463 bp LINE-1 in F9 exon E
cases.mechanism_detail: Truncated 463 bp L1 inserted into F9 exon E (letter-numbered exon), arising in the germline of the maternal grandmother; transcript effect not described in abstract.
cases.quote: 1) a 279 bp insertion in exon H originating from an Alu family of short interspersed elements not previously known to be active and, 2) a 463 bp insertion in exon E of a LINE1 element originating in the maternal grandmother.
